title: Status sits at the top of Settings but only saves with Save changes at the bottom, next to Privacy that saves at once
what_happens: Status (Open/Closed) and Privacy share the first row of the form. Privacy saves by itself after its confirm. Status only saves with 'Save changes', about 1.5 screens down; the only hint is inside its (i) tooltip.
who_hurts: An admin who comes to close a session switches Status to Closed, sees the row look done (like Privacy beside it), and leaves. The session stays open and keeps taking answers.
suggested_fix: Make Status act like Privacy: save on change (with a confirm when closing), using the same PATCH route, and drop it from the form's dirty check. Or, smaller: keep Save in view (sticky footer) when the form is dirty.
rule: Dane's UI rule: 'A control should make sense from its label; text that explains what it does goes behind a small "i" icon' (here the save behaviour only shows in the tooltip); established pattern: Privacy and Archive act at once
origin: this change (Status moved away from the Save button)
owners_call: The PR lists 'Status still saves with the form's Save button' as a decision. Should Status save on its own like Privacy?
